body: Chief: correction ACCEPTED — an identity that omits promptTemplateVersion/params/seed/cached while equality includes them is the same defect class as finding (1); attempt/v2 it is. Requirements: canonical rendering of the full indexed ProviderCall (tagged Options, cached flag, params as sorted key/value records with the same escaping rules as material/v1) plus each EmbeddingReceipt's kind/items/output identity, on top of exact call correspondence and isKeyConsistent; law: a base ProviderCall params/seed/cached mutation with identical items/outputs changes the attempt digest; v1 stays intact and ADR 0001 D6 lists both versions (rendering change = version bump, as already written). Placement: keep the v2 marker/constant and the rendering in AttemptReceipt (contract.scala) so receipt.scala stays W3's; if one constant must live in receipt.scala, send the one-line hunk to codex-storymodel-new-engineer and I apply it at merge under the paragraph rule. Everything else in your checkpoint stands. Handoff at 00:05Z unless m1 claims.
